luci-app-vantage.description: Vantage dashboard: read-only status of the device, uplink, radios and stations (wireless configuration without keys, through luci.vantage wireless), its temperature sensors (luci.vantage thermal), the wired hosts its bridges have learned (luci.vantage wired: MAC, port and when last heard, and which switch ports a port's VLAN has), the link state of those switch ports (luci getSwconfigPortState), the default route the kernel takes to the internet (luci.vantage routes: family, device and metric, no gateways) and each radio's noise floor (luci.vantage survey: the channel survey read through nl80211)

luci-app-vantage-rdns.description: Vantage dashboard: client names from reverse DNS (lets the holder make the device send DNS PTR queries to any DNS server and port it names)

luci-app-vantage-names.description: Vantage dashboard: name stations and keep a station's weak signal out of the warnings (luci.vantage set_alias and set_quiet: validated names and quiet MACs in /etc/config/vantage only, at most 512 each)
